_comment: Single source of truth for the tier-B PROBE registry (the fourth registry): named, read-only, side-effect-free context snapshots an agent fetches on demand via `track-state probe <name>`. Rows resolve plugin baseline ⊕ project overlay (conductor/workflow/probes.json, row-level replace). A probe must be CHEAP (a bounded parser or a short command); ad-hoc context scraping stays out of the registry — see conductor/design/probes.md.

_fields.description: one line: what context question this probe answers.
_fields.kind: builtin | command — builtin rows are implemented in scripts/track_state/probes.py (the name must be one it implements); command rows run the row's argv (shlex-split, no shell, 10s timeout, bounded stdout).
_fields.command: required iff kind=command — the argv string to run. MUST be read-only (the contract is reviewed, not enforced); a mutating command here is a design violation.

skill-fires.description: Dispatch starts per executor agent + wrapped skill (dispatch-lifecycle.log)

gate-outcomes.description: Pass/fail counts per task class per gate across tracks (gate-outcomes.json)
